comparisons.name: preview-knob-light
comparisons.description: Upper end of the overlay knob in Preview's document view, Aqua: the default dark knob over the flat light-blue menu-bar band of the desktop picture, 2 pt from the content's trailing edge. The band colour is set in the example.

comparisons.name: preview-knob-dark
comparisons.description: Upper end of the overlay knob in Preview's document view, Dark Aqua: the default light knob over the flat navy menu-bar band of the desktop picture. The crop's last point is the window's lighter edge, which the example does not draw, so it is masked.

comparisons.name: overlay-knob-dark
comparisons.description: Lower end of the overlay knob at full strength over the light page of a Safari window, Dark Aqua (knobStyle dark). The two trailing pixel columns of the crop are the window's edge highlight, which the example does not draw.
